items.source: This strategy does not search implemented interfaces.
items.translation: 该策略不搜索已实现的接口。

items.source: When combined with MergedAnnotations.Search.withEnclosingClasses(Predicate), enclosing classes will also be recursively searched if the supplied Predicate evaluates to true.
items.translation: 当与MergedAnnotations.Search.withEnclosingClasses(Predicate)结合使用时，如果提供的Predicate评估结果为true，则也会递归搜索enclosing classes。

items.source: This strategy is only really useful when used with Class types since the @Inherited annotation is ignored for all other annotated elements.
items.translation: 此策略仅在配合使用 Class 类型时真正有用，因为对于所有其他 带注解的元素，@Inherited 注解会被忽略。

items.source: This strategy is similar to INHERITED_ANNOTATIONS except the annotations do not need to be meta-annotated with @Inherited.
items.translation: 此策略与 INHERITED_ANNOTATIONS 类似，但注解不需要使用 @Inherited 进行元注解。

items.source: Each strategy creates a different set of aggregates that will be combined to create the final MergedAnnotations.
items.translation: 每种策略都会创建一组不同的聚合，这些聚合将组合在一起以生成最终的MergedAnnotations。

items.source: Superclass and enclosing class annotations do not need to be meta-annotated with @Inherited.
items.translation: 父类和包含类的注解不需要使用 @Inherited 进行元注解。

items.source: Find only directly declared annotations, without considering @Inherited annotations and without searching superclasses or implemented interfaces.
items.translation: 仅查找直接声明的注解，不考虑@Inherited 注解，且不搜索父类或实现的接口。

items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source: Find all directly declared annotations as well as any @Inherited superclass annotations.
items.translation: 查找所有直接声明的注解以及任何 `@Inherited` 父类注解。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）

items.source: Find all directly declared and superclass annotations.
items.translation: 查找所有直接声明和超类注解。

items.source:
Perform a full search of the entire type hierarchy, including
superclasses and implemented interfaces.
items.translation: 对整个类型层次结构执行完整搜索，包括父类和实现的接口。
